note: 中午 12 点前见面都能用，对方也回答 Good morning。

examples.en: Good morning, Miss Li!
examples.zh: 早上好，李老师！

examples.en: Good morning, Mum. I'm ready for school.
examples.zh: 早上好，妈妈。我准备好上学了。

note: 初次见面用；回答 Nice to meet you, too.

examples.en: Nice to meet you, Tom.
examples.zh: 很高兴见到你，汤姆。

examples.en: This is my new friend, Amy. Nice to meet you.
examples.zh: 这是我的新朋友艾米。很高兴见到你。

note: 回答 I'm fine, thank you. 或 Very well, thanks.

examples.en: How are you today? — I'm fine, thank you.
examples.zh: 你今天好吗？——我很好，谢谢。

examples.en: How are you, Grandma? I miss you.
examples.zh: 奶奶，您好吗？我想您了。

note: 比 Thank you 更客气，可加 for your help。

examples.en: Thank you very much for your help.
examples.zh: 非常感谢你的帮助。

examples.en: Thank you very much, Miss Wang.
examples.zh: 非常感谢您，王老师。

note: 别人说 Thank you 时用来回应。

examples.en: Here's your book. — Thank you. — You're welcome.
examples.zh: 这是你的书。——谢谢。——不客气。

examples.en: You're welcome. Come again!
examples.zh: 不客气，欢迎再来！

note: 问路、借过、提问之前先说一句更礼貌。

examples.en: Excuse me, where is the toilet?
examples.zh: 打扰一下，洗手间在哪里？

examples.en: Excuse me, may I sit here?
examples.zh: 打扰一下，我可以坐这里吗？

note: 告别用语，也可以说 See you later / See you.

examples.en: See you tomorrow, Lily! — See you!
examples.zh: 明天见，莉莉！——明天见！

examples.en: Class is over. See you tomorrow.
examples.zh: 下课了。明天见。

note: 迟到要先道歉；对方常说 That's all right.

examples.en: Sorry, I'm late. The bus was late, too.
examples.zh: 对不起，我迟到了。公交车也晚了。

examples.en: Sorry, I'm late. May I come in?
examples.zh: 对不起，我迟到了。我可以进来吗？

note: 进教室或办公室前用；回答 Come in, please.

examples.en: May I come in? — Come in, please.
examples.zh: 我可以进来吗？——请进。

examples.en: May I come in? I have a question.
examples.zh: 我可以进来吗？我有个问题。

note: 问单个近处的东西用 this，远处用 that。

examples.en: What's this in English? — It's a pencil.
examples.zh: 这个用英语怎么说？——是一支铅笔。

examples.en: What's that in English? I don't know the word.
examples.zh: 那个用英语怎么说？我不认识这个词。

note: 老师常用指令；read after sb 表示跟着某人读。

examples.en: Please read after me: apple, apple.
examples.zh: 请跟我读：apple，apple。

examples.en: Please read after me and speak loudly.
examples.zh: 请跟我读，并且大声一点。

note: 英式课堂常用；也可以说 Put up your hand.

examples.en: Hands up, please. Who knows the answer?
examples.zh: 请举手。谁知道答案？

examples.en: Hands up, please. Let's play a game.
examples.zh: 请举手。我们来玩个游戏。

note: 更礼貌的说法：Sorry, I don't know.

examples.en: What's the time? — Sorry, I don't know.
examples.zh: 几点了？——抱歉，我不知道。

examples.en: I don't know the answer. Let's ask the teacher.
examples.zh: 我不知道答案。我们去问老师吧。

note: borrow 是「借进来」，lend 是「借出去」。

examples.en: Can I borrow your pen? Mine is broken.
examples.zh: 我能借你的笔吗？我的坏了。

examples.en: Can I borrow your ruler, please? — Here you are.
examples.zh: 我能借一下你的尺子吗？——给你。

note: 也可以说 What's the time? 回答 It's + 时间.

examples.en: What time is it? — It's seven o'clock.
examples.zh: 几点了？——七点了。

examples.en: What time is it now? We must hurry.
examples.zh: 现在几点了？我们得快点。

note: 回答 It's Monday / Tuesday …，星期前不加 on。

examples.en: What day is it today? — It's Wednesday.
examples.zh: 今天星期几？——星期三。

examples.en: What day is it today? Is it Friday?
examples.zh: 今天星期几？是星期五吗？

note: for 后接名词；后接动词用 It's time to + 动词。

examples.en: It's time for class. Let's go in.
examples.zh: 该上课了，我们进去吧。

examples.en: It's time for lunch. I'm hungry.
examples.zh: 该吃午饭了，我饿了。

phrase: I get up at six thirty
note: 具体时刻前用 at；get up 是「起床」。

examples.en: I get up at six thirty every morning.
examples.zh: 我每天早上六点半起床。

examples.en: I get up at six thirty and go to school at seven.
examples.zh: 我六点半起床，七点去上学。

note: 回答具体某天用 on，如 It's on May 1st.

examples.en: When is your birthday? — It's on May 1st.
examples.zh: 你的生日是什么时候？——在五月一日。

examples.en: When is your birthday? I want to make a card for you.
examples.zh: 你的生日是什么时候？我想给你做张卡片。

note: 道别时的祝福语；也可以说 Have a nice day.

examples.en: Goodbye! Have a good day!
examples.zh: 再见！祝你今天愉快！

examples.en: Have a good day at school, dear.
examples.zh: 孩子，在学校过得愉快。

note: 回答 It's sunny / rainy / windy / cold.

examples.en: What's the weather like today? — It's sunny.
examples.zh: 今天天气怎么样？——晴天。

examples.en: What's the weather like today? Can we go out?
examples.zh: 今天天气怎么样？我们能出去玩吗？

phrase: How many people are there in your family?
note: There be 句型问数量，回答 There are + 数字。

examples.en: How many people are there in your family? — There are four.
examples.zh: 你家有几口人？——四口人。

examples.en: How many people are there in your family? Is your grandma with you?
examples.zh: 你家有几口人？奶奶和你们一起住吗？

note: 介绍别人用 This is …，不用 He is …。

examples.en: This is my mother. She is a nurse.
examples.zh: 这是我妈妈，她是一名护士。

examples.en: Mum, this is my teacher, Miss Li.
examples.zh: 妈妈，这是我的老师李老师。

note: 回答 Yes, please. 或 No, thanks.

examples.en: Would you like some juice? — Yes, please.
examples.zh: 你想要些果汁吗？——好的，谢谢。

examples.en: Would you like some juice or water? — Water, please.
examples.zh: 你要果汁还是水？——水，谢谢。

note: 把东西递给别人时说；单数也可说 Here it is.

examples.en: Can I have a look? — Here you are.
examples.zh: 我能看看吗？——给你。

examples.en: Here you are, a cup of tea for you.
examples.zh: 给你，一杯茶。

note: 问价格；复数物品用 How much are they?

examples.en: How much is it? — It's ten yuan.
examples.zh: 这个多少钱？——十元。

examples.en: How much is this bag? It's too expensive.
examples.zh: 这个包多少钱？太贵了。

phrase: I want to buy a book
note: want to + 动词原形，表示「想要做某事」。

examples.en: I want to buy a book about animals.
examples.zh: 我想买一本关于动物的书。

examples.en: I want to buy a birthday present for my sister.
examples.zh: 我想给妹妹买一份生日礼物。

note: 指路常用；右转是 turn right。

examples.en: Turn left at the corner and you will see the bank.
examples.zh: 在拐角处左转，你就会看到银行。

examples.en: Go along this street, then turn left at the corner.
examples.zh: 沿着这条街走，然后在拐角处左转。

note: 回答 I like + 动词 -ing，或 My hobby is …。

examples.en: What's your hobby? — I like drawing.
examples.zh: 你的爱好是什么？——我喜欢画画。

examples.en: What's your hobby? Mine is reading.
examples.zh: 你的爱好是什么？我的是阅读。

note: Let's 后面一定跟动词原形。

examples.en: Let's play football together after school.
examples.zh: 放学后我们一起踢足球吧。

examples.en: Let's play football together. It's fun!
examples.zh: 我们一起踢足球吧，很好玩！
